name: Nova Taggering
summary: Run, Jump, Climb. Don't fall! This application was designed to make you feel at home swinging away like a monkey with no legs and 2 arms. Welcome.. To.. Nova Taggering! Go have fun and explore the map, while your installing this game. We would love it if you gave it a review of you HONEST opinion like, 5 Stars - I LOVED THIS GAME, 4 Stars - I LIKE THIS GAME BUT IT COULD USE SOME IMPROVEMENTS, 3 Stars - THIS GAME IS KINDA GOOD - NEEDS ALOT OF IMPROVEMENT, 2-1 Stars - I DONT LIKE THIS GAME.
